title: Director of Manufacturing and Quality
text:
For our client, we are seeking a Director of Manufacturing and Quality to join the team of a leader in the Consumer Technology space.
 
 
This leader will own the global manufacturing strategy and quality execution for a hardware-driven business operating across design, production, and supply chain partners. The role will be central to scaling high-volume manufacturing, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring product quality from early design through full production. You will work closely with engineering, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional partners to strengthen launch readiness, vendor accountability, and long-term quality performance.
 
 
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
 
 
Compensation: $200,000 – $250,000 annually
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and execute the global manufacturing strategy, including optimization of production facilities
* Drive NPI handoffs from design to high-volume manufacturing with robust playbooks
* Optimize production capacity and efficiency through innovative layout and automation designs
* Manage technical execution at tier-1 contract manufacturers and oversee vendor accountability
* Own and improve the global Quality Management System across all sites and partners
* Implement early design quality practices to mitigate manufacturing issues through the lifecycle
* Lead global failure analysis and corrective action processes to maintain product quality

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of leadership experience in hardware manufacturing operations, NPI, and quality engineering in high-tech industries
* Direct experience establishing and scaling overseas manufacturing facilities, particularly in Asia
* Deep understanding of electrical fabrication and mechanical processes
* Expertise in advanced quality methodologies such as Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field; an MS or MBA is a plus

**Benefits**

* 100% premium coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Equity options available in the form of stock options
* 401(k) match to support retirement savings
* Reimbursement for work-from-home hardware expenses

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification—your background could be exactly what this team needs.
